text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having recently conquered both the Satsuki 
Sho and the Japanese Derby, Symboli Rudolf 
became an undefeated Double Crown 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The public hailed the free-spirited and 
daring Mr. C.B. as "amazing," while 
praising Symboli Rudolf, who ran textbook 
winning races, as "strong."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. is glad to be blessed with great 
rivals. And so, she headed for the stage 
of her showdown with Katsuragi Ace: the 
Takarazuka Kinen.
